\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 201-204 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R209-first-pass-words-from-chapters-201-204}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for healthy and broken.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item an injection, an operation, a bruise, a burn, a stomach cramp
  \item usually, immediately, later, a date; history, a moment
  \item previously, finally, during, a century, weekly
  \item towards, an area, a centre, a capital city, where
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
An injection? (\textbf{\ar{حقنة}}, \emph{ḥuqna}.) An operation? (\textbf{\ar{عملية}}, \emph{ʿamaliyya}.) A bruise? (\textbf{\ar{كدمة}}, \emph{kadma}.) A burn? (\textbf{\ar{حرق}}, \emph{ḥarq}.) A stomach cramp? (\textbf{\ar{مغص}}, \emph{maghaṣ}.) Usually? (\textbf{\ar{غالبا}}, \emph{ghāliban}.) Immediately? (\textbf{\ar{فورا}}, \emph{fawran}.) Later? (\textbf{\ar{لاحقا}}, \emph{lāḥiqan}.) A date; history? (\textbf{\ar{تاريخ}}, \emph{tārīkh}.) A moment? (\textbf{\ar{لحظة}}, \emph{laḥẓa}.) Previously? (\textbf{\ar{سابقا}}, \emph{sābiqan}.) Finally? (\textbf{\ar{أخيرا}}, \emph{akhīran}.) During? (\textbf{\ar{أثناء}}, \emph{athnāʾa}.) A century? (\textbf{\ar{قرن}}, \emph{qarn}.) Weekly? (\textbf{\ar{أسبوعي}}, \emph{usbūʿī}.) Towards? (\textbf{\ar{نحو}}, \emph{naḥwa}.) An area? (\textbf{\ar{منطقة}}, \emph{minṭaqa}.) A centre? (\textbf{\ar{مركز}}, \emph{markaz}.) A capital city? (\textbf{\ar{عاصمة}}, \emph{ʿāṣima}.) Where? (\textbf{\ar{أين}}, \emph{ayna}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 205-209 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R209-second-pass-words-from-chapters-205-209}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for nature and dust.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item nature, dust, mud, borders, a planet
  \item perhaps, a problem, a solution, joy, fear
  \item only, very, even; until, if, as
  \item a meaning, an example, freedom, a rule, a way
  \item grilled, boiled, burnt, healthy, broken
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Nature? (\textbf{\ar{طبيعة}}, \emph{ṭabīʿa}.) Dust? (\textbf{\ar{تراب}}, \emph{turāb}.) Mud? (\textbf{\ar{طين}}, \emph{ṭīn}.) Borders? (\textbf{\ar{حدود}}, \emph{ḥudūd}.) A planet? (\textbf{\ar{كوكب}}, \emph{kawkab}.) Perhaps? (\textbf{\ar{ربما}}, \emph{rubbamā}.) A problem? (\textbf{\ar{مشكلة}}, \emph{mushkila}.) A solution? (\textbf{\ar{حل}}, \emph{ḥall}.) Joy? (\textbf{\ar{بهجة}}, \emph{bahja}.) Fear? (\textbf{\ar{خوف}}, \emph{khawf}.) Only? (\textbf{\ar{فقط}}, \emph{faqaṭ}.) Very? (\textbf{\ar{جدا}}, \emph{jiddan}.) Even; until? (\textbf{\ar{حتى}}, \emph{ḥattā}.) If? (\textbf{\ar{إذا}}, \emph{idhā}.) As? (\textbf{\ar{كما}}, \emph{kamā}.) A meaning? (\textbf{\ar{معنى}}, \emph{maʿnā}.) An example? (\textbf{\ar{مثال}}, \emph{mithāl}.) Freedom? (\textbf{\ar{حرية}}, \emph{ḥurriyya}.) A rule? (\textbf{\ar{قاعدة}}, \emph{qāʿida}.) A way? (\textbf{\ar{طريقة}}, \emph{ṭarīqa}.) Grilled? (\textbf{\ar{مشوي}}, \emph{mashwī}.) Boiled? (\textbf{\ar{مسلوق}}, \emph{maslūq}.) Burnt? (\textbf{\ar{محروق}}, \emph{maḥrūq}.) Healthy? (\textbf{\ar{صحي}}, \emph{ṣiḥḥī}.) Broken? (\textbf{\ar{مكسور}}, \emph{maksūr}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
